resultTabs.label: Complexity
resultTabs.description: Guaranteed circuit-size lower-bound envelopes for fixed eligible uniform NP families in full B2, at actual input length n and all sufficiently large integer lengths. Logarithms are base 2. Exact leading terms and quantified v2 remainders determine the table ordering; finite coefficient/exponent scores remain a projection. Authenticated v1 liminf guarantees keep their original meaning.
